Definition: from G3306; a staying, i.e. residence (the act or the place):--abode, mansion.
BiblicalUsage: Mone is an abode, a dwelling place — in My Father's house are many mansions, Jesus says on the night before the cross, and He promises that He and the Father will come and make their abode with the one who loves Him and keeps His word.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the promise runs both ways: there is a room for me in His house, and a home for Him in mine.
RelatedTopics: Heaven; Presence of God; Love for God
